product_one_liner.value: Axure RP lets UX designers, product managers, and business analysts create wireframes and interactive software prototypes without writing code.
product_one_liner.notes: https://www.axure.com/a/ux-prototyping-tool identifies UX designers, product managers, and business analysts as users and describes no-code wireframing and interactive prototyping.

pricing_page.notes: https://www.axure.com/pricing publicly lists Axure RP Pro and Team plans with per-user prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: https://www.axure.com/axure-customers describes both PROS and Syncron using Axure RP. | named_customers.0: The customer page describes PROS's team creating custom-tailored demonstrations with Axure RP. | named_customers.1: The customer page states that Syncron's teams use Axure RP prototypes.

employee_band.notes: The company profile at https://linkedin.com/company/axure-software-solutions reports 17 employees, which maps to the required 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: https://linkedin.com/company/axure-software-solutions lists the company's location as San Diego, California. | hq_country: The company location on https://linkedin.com/company/axure-software-solutions is San Diego, California, United States.

founded_year.notes: Axure's company profile at https://linkedin.com/company/axure-software-solutions states a founding year of 2002.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index at https://www.axure.com/blog lists product announcements, tutorials, and UX/marketing content. It does not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how Axure itself is built, so it does not meet the specified engineering-blog threshold.

public_docs.notes: https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp is a public documentation portal containing multiple guides and tutorials, including getting started, hiding/showing widgets, and interactive buttons.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete openings section at https://www.axure.com/careers lists Senior Software Engineer only. That title does not qualify as an AI, ML, or data-science opening under the specified rules.

model_provider.notes: The documentation at https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/mcp/ and https://docs.axure.com/axure-cloud/reference/MCP describes MCP servers connecting user-selected external AI tools, not an underlying model provider used by Axure. The blog, security, privacy, and subprocessor disclosures were also checked without finding such a disclosure. Claude and ChatGPT compatibility therefore is not treated as evidence of Axure's own model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: https://www.axure.com/security claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification, and https://www.axure.com/gdpr states GDPR compliance. The security page also claims PCI compliance for transmitting credit-card information. PCI DSS is included with that limited scope: the separate Level 1 certification statement applies to Axure's payment processor, not to Axure itself. | compliance_certs.0: Axure's security page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification. | compliance_certs.1: Axure describes its ISO 27001 certification as achieved, not in progress. | compliance_certs.2: Axure's legal page explicitly states its commitment to GDPR compliance. | compliance_certs.3: Axure claims PCI compliance for transmitting credit-card information, and the page names PCI DSS. This does not establish that Axure itself holds the processor's separately stated Level 1 certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The profiles at https://tracxn.com/d/companies/axure/__G0DHSuLnHkRVkS9_cp6rAQk-hMmzaofWA1Ei2s0vqtE and https://app.dealroom.co/companies/axure_software_solutions report no funding rounds or known external funding. The required stage is therefore none. | funding_date: The funding profile at https://tracxn.com/d/companies/axure/__G0DHSuLnHkRVkS9_cp6rAQk-hMmzaofWA1Ei2s0vqtE reports no rounds, so there is no latest-round date to provide. | funding_amount_usd: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/axure/__G0DHSuLnHkRVkS9_cp6rAQk-hMmzaofWA1Ei2s0vqtE reports no funding rounds. Consequently, no latest-round amount applies; null does not represent a zero-dollar round.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profiles at https://tracxn.com/d/companies/axure/__G0DHSuLnHkRVkS9_cp6rAQk-hMmzaofWA1Ei2s0vqtE and https://app.dealroom.co/companies/axure_software_solutions establish no known outside funding, supporting false under the specified rule.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: https://www.axure.com/careers lists only Senior Software Engineer, with no SDR, BDR, sales-development representative, business-development representative, or account-executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 24, 2026 announcement at https://www.axure.com/changelog/2026-09-24 introduces a built-in Axure RP MCP server that exposes design context to AI tools. This substantive new integration falls inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated qualifying executive appointment or departure was found, and a complete leadership history could not be established. Neither a positive nor the required evidence-based negative could be verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Axure's subprocessor list at https://www.axure.com/gdpr identifies HubSpot for email marketing and analytics and Mailchimp for email marketing. These are direct operational-use disclosures rather than merely available integrations. | crm_stack_signal.0: HubSpot is listed as an Axure subprocessor for email marketing and analytics. | crm_stack_signal.1: Mailchimp is listed as an Axure subprocessor for email marketing.
